content:
sarah: Heads-up — airgap bundle and installer for private/VPC release v1.6.0-priv are built and signed. Requesting a change window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC for delivery to customer buckets. Need version pin confirmation and rollback plan.

build-bot: CI pipeline finished: artifacts uploaded.
build-bot: installer: s3://releases/private/v1.6.0-priv/installer-v1.6.0-priv.tar.gz sha256=3a7f9c2b9d1e5b6c4d2f8a77f3a2b1c6e9d4f1a2c3b4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a size=1.2GB
build-bot: airgap bundle: s3://releases/private/v1.6.0-priv/airgap-bundle-v1.6.0-priv.tar.gz sha256=9f8d7c6b5a4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c size=9.6GB
build-bot: artifacts signed with key id: KMS-RELEASE-2026-03, cosign signatures at s3://releases/private/v1.6.0-priv/cosign/

deploy-bot: Pre-release checks: smoke tests=PASS, e2e=PASS (non-blocking flaky test flagged), vuln-scan=1 medium (vendor lib, tracked), kube compatibility matrix OK.

mike: Quick ask — we should pin the operator and infra images to avoid drift. Propose: `redwood/kube-operator:0.9.2` and `redwood/infra:2.4.1-priv`.

sarah: Agree. We'll pin images in the installer manifest and provide digests. Installer manifest snippet:```
images:
  kube-operator: "redwood/kube-operator@sha256:5b3c4d..."
  infra: "redwood/infra@sha256:7d2a1f..."
```

jordan: Rollback plan: if canary error rate > 3% or avg latency + p95 > 30% baseline, revert routing to v1.5.3-priv and redeploy stable image digest. Steps: 1) pause rollout, 2) set traffic to stable via router (flag: `--traffic=stable`), 3) trigger redeploy with pinned digest, 4) invalidate KV caches if necessary.

alex: Are all image manifests signed (cosign)? Customers will verify signatures in airgapped environment. Need public key + chain distributed in bundle. Also confirm OCI manifest digests included.

build-bot: Yes — cosign used for container images. Example verify command included in bundle: `cosign verify --key cosign.pub redwood/infra@sha256:7d2a1f...` Sig files: `infra@sha256:7d2a1f...sig` at s3 path above. We'll include `cosign.pub` and the KMS key reference in the release notes.

tara: I'll ping security for a quick review of the signing artifacts and audit retention. Also confirming KMS rotation window doesn't overlap the deploy window.

sarah: Change window confirmed pending one more security thumbs-up. Canary plan: 10% for 10m, 30% for 15m, 60% for 20m, then 100%. Auto-rollback triggers: error-rate>3% OR p95 latency increase>30% OR stateful job failure.

deploy-bot: Deploy schedule created by @sarah: start=2026-03-21T02:00:00Z end=2026-03-21T04:00:00Z. Canary steps configured. Manual hold at each stage. Post-deploy: artifacts will be copied to customer bucket `gs://customer-a-private/v1.6.0-priv/` and release notes published.

mike: Make sure to call out known medium vuln in release notes and mitigation (vendor patch plan).

jordan: For rollback target we will use `v1.5.3-priv` stable digest: sha256:4c1b2a3f5e6d7c8b9a0f1e2d3c4b5a6f. Keep that handy in the runbook.

sarah: I'll update the release runbook, include exact `kubectl` rollback commands, and attach signed manifests to the runbook. Example rollback command: `kubectl set image -n redwood deploy/kube-operator kube-operator=redwood/kube-operator@sha256:4c1b2a...`

alex: One more: confirm airgap bundle checksums are in `checksums.txt` at top-level of tar. We'll also add an automated verification script:```
#!/bin/bash
sha256sum -c checksums.txt || exit 1
cosign verify --key cosign.pub redwood/infra@sha256:7d2a1f...
```

build-bot: Added `checksums.txt` and `verify-release.sh` to bundle.

tara: Security sign-off: tentative, will confirm within 2 hours. If anything fails, we should delay by 24 hours to rotate keys.

sarah: OK — last call for objections. If no objections, we'll proceed with the scheduled window and I'll post final release notes + customer instructions after sec sign-off.

mike: No objections from infra. :thumbsup:

jordan: Runbook updated and shared. Ready on-call.

deploy-bot: Reminder: set PagerDuty override to `private-release` during window.

sarah: Great — thanks all. I'll post final status and the signed manifest link in this thread once security confirms. :white_check_mark:
